arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Tseytlin argued the Clean Air Act channels national actions to the D.C. Circuit.
He stated local actions like state plan approvals go to regional circuits.
Mr. Stewart noted both sides discussed EPA deference on forum questions.
Mr. Mansinghani stated state plan approvals are prototypical regional circuit actions.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The Clean Air Act directs national EPA actions to the D.C. Circuit. It sends local or regional actions to regional courts. Oklahoma claims state plan approvals are national. The EPA claims they are local. The Court must decide which forum applies.
